name: classify-and-route
description: Classify a user's intent, then route coding queries to a cheaper code model and chat to a sub-workflow. Each Model node carries a max_cost_usd admission estimate; the Branch picks one path. An eligible retained terminal run can be minted on demand as a signed estimate (POST /v1/admin/workflow-runs/{run_id}/receipt/sign).

nodes.prompt: Classify the user's intent into exactly one of: code, chat. Respond with the single word. Input: {{input.text}}
Answer the coding question concisely. Input: {{input.text}}
